description: §6.7.7 a `<request>` body that calls a CLIENT function reaching a server function gets the full request machinery (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). `pick(id)` returns `loadUser(id)`; the body is `@userData = pick(@userId)`. On mount the fetch settles (.loading false, @userData = user 1), and changing the inferred dep @userId re-fetches user 2 ("b"). Pre-S444 the settle machine was built only for a DIRECT server-fn call: the cell received an unawaited Promise at module init, .loading stuck true, and no dep effect existed.
rationale: §6.7.7: "The `<request>` body calls a server function." + EC-2 "The compiler SHALL generate a sequence number per `<request>` instance."; §13.2: the author writes no asynchrony. g-request-body-client-wrapper-unawaited-one-shot (S444).
